prediction_unit: complete recording trial; one feature row and one prediction per trial
label_semantics: reference contraction condition versus sustained 30% peak-torque knee-extension task carried to task failure; not an instantaneous or per-window physiological fatigue state
force_trace_use: uncalibrated reference force is used only to find active contraction bouts and exclude short post-task MVC; never enters any model feature or target
sampling_rate_hz: read from each MAT file; expected to be 2048 Hz

windows.type: fixed-length sliding windows inside detected active bouts
windows.window_target: none; windows are pooled to a complete-trial feature vector, and the CNN pools window logits before computing one trial-level loss

filter.bandpass: scipy.signal.butter(N=4, Wn=[20,450] Hz, btype='bandpass', fs=measured_fs, output='sos')
filter.application: zero-phase scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt independently within detected active bouts
filter.conditional_notch: Q=30 at 50 or 60 Hz only if pooled Welch PSD prominence exceeds 10 dB; coefficients and decisions saved in processing_audit.csv

feature_formulas.psd: one-sided periodogram using Hann window and density scaling
feature_formulas.mdf_hz: first f_k where cumulative Pxx reaches 0.5 * sum(Pxx), for 20<=f<=450 Hz
feature_formulas.channel_pooling: median over usable RF electrode channels per window
feature_formulas.trial_pooling: median, interquartile range, and least-squares slope across active-time-normalized windows
